name: H. Lundbeck A/S
summary: H. Lundbeck A/S engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercializing pharmaceuticals for the treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders in Europe, United States, and internationally. The company offers Abilify Maintena/ Abilify Asimtufii for schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder in adults; Brintellix/Trintellix to treat depressive disorders; Rexulti/Rxulti to treat major depressive disorder and schizophrenia; Vyepti for migraine prevention; and Cipralex/Lexapro for depression.
